spec:
In tools/fleet_gui.py:
1. In FleetControlApp.__init__(), initialize self._stop_tailer = False, self._daemon_log_pos = 0, and start background daemon thread self._start_daemon_log_tailer().
2. Implement _start_daemon_log_tailer(self):
   Locates daemon_log_path = self.state_dir / 'logs' / 'worker_daemon.log'.
   If it exists, initialize self._daemon_log_pos to the end of the file on startup (or last 20 lines) to avoid flooding.
   Runs loop while not self._destroyed and not self._stop_tailer: sleeps 1.0s, seeks to self._daemon_log_pos, reads new lines, and for each line calls self.log(f'[DAEMON] {line.strip()}'). Updates self._daemon_log_pos.
3. In destroy(self): set self._stop_tailer = True before calling super().destroy().
Ensure all tests in tests/test_fleet_gui.py pass.
